sprint.name: Discovery Alpha Activation — First Design Partner
sprint.classification: B — Activation Valid; Bounded Blockers Remain
sprint.scope: Feature-flagged activation of the authenticated, organization-scoped Your Organization path through durable access, Runtime disclosure, projection, product communication, and the existing UI.

evidence.claimBoundary: Twenty-three local PostgreSQL-backed checks cover owner, denial, revocation, wrong organization, missing stages, audit, determinism, non-mutation, and rollback.
Server-only access-before-Runtime orchestration for the single feature-flagged Your Organization route.
Activation architecture, inactive boundaries, rollback, validation, readiness, and hosted blockers.
Sixty PostgreSQL lifecycle, isolation, audit, failure, replay, CLI, and activation-boundary checks.

scorecard.rationale: The activation consumes existing canonical Organizational Understanding and does not create or alter cognition.
The path is locally validated but no design-partner comprehension, trust, or decision outcome has been measured.
No collaboration, contribution, organization creation, or shared-learning workflow was activated.
Verified identity, exact organization scope, access-before-Runtime ordering, revocation, authority-qualified disclosure, and append-only audit now govern the active bounded path.
One environment flag provides exact route rollback, failures remain explicit, and the activation composes existing owners without duplicating cognition.

architecture.observation: The first authenticated product path now composes governance, Runtime, projection, communication, and UI owners end to end.
Cognition is not expanded, Runtime is loaded once after authorization, and replay confirms no mutation.

benchmarks.summary: The complete local authenticated delivery path and all requested denial, missing-stage, audit, determinism, and rollback cases pass.
Durable access and audit behavior remains passing after bounded activation.

researchObservations.observation: No benchmark-only research object, adapter, result, or conclusion changed or became product-visible.

introduced: A server-only activation orchestrator and pure projection-to-view composer.
One route-level feature flag, Clerk boundary, bounded middleware matcher, sign-out control, and explicit unavailable states.
complexity.justification: A real authenticated product path requires explicit orchestration across existing owners; the additions are isolated to one route and have one-step rollback.

governanceObservations.observation: The approved allowlist policy now controls the only activated product path without broadening policy or disclosure scope.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: The default route remains the rollback path, unsupported stages fail closed, and no data migration is required to deactivate.

regressions.observation: Your Organization changes data delivery only when flagged; other product experiences remain unavailable in the bounded Alpha.
Runtime replay is deterministic and the activation neither writes nor mutates Runtime.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: Production tenant configuration, hosted roles, pooling, browser sessions, and deployed callbacks were not available in local validation.
No external design partner has used the activated path.
Monitoring, alerting, backup recovery, deployment smoke tests, and release rollback remain to be demonstrated.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: Remediate production dependency vulnerabilities and verify deployed Clerk, Neon, Runtime persistence, secrets, monitoring, and rollback.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Complete bounded hosted Alpha operations, then enable the flag only for the provisioned design partner; do not expand architecture.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: A deployed browser replay with the real identity provider, hosted database, hosted Runtime, and design-partner organization remains unmeasured.

rollback.description: Set DISCOVERY_ALPHA_YOUR_ORGANIZATION_ENABLED=false to restore the committed Phase 8A route and disable the Clerk activation boundary without changing Runtime or stored audit history.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept Classification B: bounded local activation is valid and reversible, while external access remains blocked until hosted security and operational evidence exists.
